text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognizing images, or making decisions. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed instructions, computers learn patterns from data. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks like speech recognition. AI is already part of daily life. It helps us unlock our phones with face recognition and suggests films we might enjoy. It also powers virtual assistants and helps doctors detect diseases earlier. AI is changing the way we live and work.
